verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly supports retention control. n8n can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, on-premises or in a private cloud, so execution data stays on systems you control, and community users value this for handling client data. One user also notes it keeps all historical executions, but no evidence documents retention policies or deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented execution-data retention/pruning settings, explicit deletion controls (UI/API), cloud-plan retention policy, independent corroboration of retention management.
